insights.summary: The ICIP 2026 author rebuttal process began on the planned date, 2026-04-07, with reviewers' comments sent to authors.

citations.quote: Author Rebuttal Process, which is scheduled to begin on Tuesday, April 7, 2026.
On April 7, all authors will receive an email containing the comments by reviewers on the submission
The Author Rebuttal process has officially begun. Below, you will find the reviewers' comments for your submission.

insights.summary: On 2026-04-08 at 05:16 an email (labelled a resend) arrived with the ICIP 2026 rebuttal form link and unique code, within the planned 2026-04-08 window.

citations.quote: Within the next 24 hours, the Corresponding Author will receive a separate email containing a link to a Microsoft Form and a unique code for this submission.
This message contains the link to the IEEE ICIP 2026 rebuttal form and the unique code specific to your submission

insights.summary: The ICIP 2026 author registration deadline of June 17, 2026 (AoE) is restated in c0; c1 shows Alan's paper still unregistered, with no sign the date changed.

citations.quote:
the author registration deadline, as
